summary: Plaintiff first raised attorneys’ fees in its opening term sheet, and the fee amount was negotiated alongside class relief before the final class fund was settled. The transcript does not show any explicit tradeoff linking a higher or unopposed fee to lower class relief, nor any plaintiff self-interest reasoning prioritizing firm compensation. There is no reverse auction, defense fee leverage, or misleading declaration; the declaration expressly states counsel does not claim fees were discussed only after class relief was agreed.
